a Client tried to charge today 06/02 on chargers 313508370046 and 313483122003 between
12:56:53
and
13:16:07
(CU time).
For all three charging attempts, 2 on charger 313508370046 (1th attempt at
12:56:53 CU time, 2th attempt at 13:07:52 CU time)
and 1 on charger 313483122003 (1th attempt at
13:16:06 CU time)
an error occurred and the recharge was 0.
Is it possible to do a log check and let us know, please?
Thanks in advance.
Regards,
Manuela.

additional_info.subject: ID0476988-DC/Si-D/IT- [Multi] Log check on charger CRM:03289000487
additional_info.body:
Dear
Manuela,
Following your request and after completing our checks, we found that some of the charging sessions you mentioned showed
zero power delivery
. This was due to the EV side, which was not requesting any target power for delivery. As a result, the recorded request was 0, as shown in the attached screenshots.
Additionally, only one charging session failed due to a charger-side error related to the main breaker. As indicated in the attached screenshots, this error is no longer appearing.
We will continue to monitor the charger closely, and if the error occurs again, we will take the necessary actions to resolve the issue.
Please let us know if you need any further clarification.
Kind regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
